nodes.label: Collections System (#Collection convention)
nodes.rationale: Playlists whose name contains '#Collection' are treated as album collections. Chosen because it piggybacks on plain Spotify playlists: existing playlists can be converted to collections and back on the fly without breaking the user's existing organization, and no server-side storage is needed. Marked core business logic - must not be changed without maintainer approval.

nodes.label: Album Playlists (Collections feature)
nodes.rationale: Spotify has no notion of album playlists; the author's main pain point. Implemented as a keyword check on playlist names so users keep 'classic' playlists underneath.

nodes.label: Spotify API Restrictions
nodes.rationale: The Web API exposes no folder management, so the playlist list is necessarily flat; the API also refuses non-premium accounts, which is why Beardify is premium-only.

nodes.label: Premium-Only Constraint
nodes.rationale: Spotify Web API playback endpoints reject free accounts, so the app targets premium users exclusively.

nodes.label: OAuth 2.0 PKCE Authentication
nodes.rationale: PKCE avoids shipping a client secret in a browser app; token refreshed every 30 minutes and session persisted in localStorage.

nodes.label: instance() API Helper
nodes.rationale: All Spotify Web API calls funnel through instance() from src/api.ts rather than raw ky, so auth headers and error handling live in one place. discogs.ts and other external APIs are the deliberate exception since they hit non-Spotify endpoints.

nodes.label: Optimistic Player Updates
nodes.rationale: Player state is mutated locally before the API call resolves and reverted on failure, eliminating visual latency on play/pause/next/seek/shuffle/repeat and volume.

nodes.label: Volume Lock Window
nodes.rationale: setVolume() sets volumeLockUntil = Date.now() + VOLUME_LOCK_DURATION_MS so external playback-state polling cannot overwrite the optimistic volume while the request is in flight.

nodes.label: Player Loading Watchdog
nodes.rationale: PlayerIndex.vue watches current_track.id; if null for 5s while no device switch is in progress it calls getExternalPlayerState() to recover from SDK stalls after a device switch.

nodes.label: Device Heartbeat
nodes.rationale: Runs every 4 minutes to keep the active device alive; after 3 consecutive failures it notifies the user and reconnects, with a 5-minute cooldown to avoid notification spam.

nodes.label: Device Switching State Machine
nodes.source_location: Player Architecture > Device Switching State Machine
nodes.rationale: setDevice() queues targets in lastRequestedDeviceId while isSettingDevice is true so overlapping switch requests collapse into one; _finalizeDeviceSwitch() picks up the queued target.

nodes.label: Native CSS Theming System
nodes.rationale: Sass was dropped in favour of native CSS nesting plus custom properties (--bg-color-*, --font-color-*, --primary-color-*), imported once from App.vue. Component-local values become namespaced custom properties because bare names would inherit into child components and leak.

nodes.label: Font Utility Classes
nodes.rationale: Replaces the former @include font-bold Sass mixin: font-bold / font-italic / font-bold-italic classes bundle font-variation-settings with the @supports not font-tech(variations) fallback. Raw declarations stay local only for conditional cases (:hover, pseudo-elements, media queries) that a static class cannot express.

nodes.label: Custom Media Breakpoints
nodes.rationale: Native media conditions cannot take var(), so breakpoints live as @custom-media in breakpoints.css resolved at build time by postcss-custom-media; @csstools/postcss-global-data exposes them to every scoped <style> block with no per-file import.

nodes.label: Lint Pipeline (TS + ESLint + Stylelint)
nodes.rationale: With no test framework in the project, linting is the primary quality gate; Prettier was removed and formatting moved into ESLint stylistic rules to keep a single source of truth.

nodes.label: Flag SVG Asset Pipeline
nodes.rationale: flag-icons SVGs are not bundled: dev serves them through Vite middleware from node_modules, prod copies them to dist/flags via vite-plugin-static-copy plus an explicit cp in netlify.toml.

nodes.label: Spotify SDK Error Suppression
nodes.rationale: Non-critical Spotify Web Playback SDK errors are intentionally swallowed in main.ts so console noise from the third-party SDK does not mask real failures.

nodes.label: Spotify Web Playback SDK Script Tag
nodes.author: @BeardedBear
nodes.rationale: Loaded from sdk.scdn.co as a module script in the HTML shell rather than npm, because the SDK registers a global ready callback and is not distributed as a package.
nodes.norm_label: spotify web playback sdk script tag

nodes.label: Inline App Shell Loader
nodes.author: @BeardedBear
nodes.rationale: A spinner styled with inline CSS inside #app paints before the Vue bundle executes, avoiding a blank screen on cold load; it is replaced when Vue mounts.

nodes.label: Beardify Icon Font
nodes.rationale: Generated icon webfont (fonts/Beardify.woff2 + style.css) with a standalone demo/reference page listing every glyph; style.css is linked directly from index.html.

nodes.label: Tauri v2 Desktop Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Native shell around the same webapp so the browser build keeps working unchanged; its reason to exist is Windows-only integration (taskbar thumbnail controls) plus an auto-updater.

nodes.label: Desktop OAuth Deep-Link Relay
nodes.rationale: Spotify rejects the tauri:// custom protocol as a redirect URI, so production desktop builds redirect to a static desktop-auth.html on the web domain which immediately forwards to the beardify:// deep link. Dev builds skip this and reuse http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth.

nodes.label: Windows Thumbnail Toolbar (thumbar.rs)
nodes.rationale: Subclasses the main window via SetWindowLongPtrW, adds prev/play-pause/next through ITaskbarList3::ThumbBarAddButtons on TaskbarButtonCreated, and emits a thumbar-action event on THBN_CLICKED. Ships without HICON resources (tooltips identify buttons) as a deliberate shortcut; adding icons means populating hIcon and THB_ICON in build_buttons().

nodes.label: Tauri Icon Generation Step
nodes.rationale: tauri build fails until icons exist in src-tauri/icons/; tauri dev falls back to a default icon, which is why the step is one-time bootstrap rather than part of the build.

nodes.label: scripts/release.ts Version Bumper
nodes.rationale: Bumps the version in package.json and src-tauri/tauri.conf.json in lockstep, commits, tags and pushes; the tag push is the sole trigger for the release workflow.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions Release Workflow
nodes.rationale: Triggers on v*.*.* tags, builds on windows-latest with bun + stable Rust (cached via Swatinem/rust-cache on the src-tauri workspace), injects all VITE_* secrets and the Tauri signing key, then publishes installers plus latest.json as a GitHub Release.

nodes.label: Tauri Minisign Signing Secrets
nodes.rationale: TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY / _PASSWORD sign update artifacts so the in-app updater can cryptographically verify a download before installing it.

nodes.label: scripts/package-release.ts
nodes.rationale: Collects the Tauri bundle output into releases/<version>/ and generates the latest.json update manifest consumed by the in-app updater.

nodes.label: In-App Updater
nodes.rationale: On startup (5-second delay, desktop only) it fetches latest.json from the GitHub releases 'latest/download' URL, shows a bottom-right toast when a newer version exists, and verifies the signature before installing. Deliberately inert in the browser build.

nodes.label: Claude Code GitHub Action
nodes.rationale: Runs anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 only when '@claude' appears in an issue, comment, or review body; granted actions:read specifically so it can read CI results on PRs, and otherwise read-only permissions.

nodes.label: Community Impact Enforcement Ladder
nodes.rationale: Four graduated consequences (Correction, Warning, Temporary Ban, Permanent Ban) adapted from Mozilla's code of conduct enforcement ladder, so responses scale with severity and repetition.
